description: Read a variable shared between the agent and the user's phone (for example a location, a plan or a preference a Shortcut stored). Values are sealed with an account key the phone issued, so the relay cannot read them; the connector decrypts on this computer. Returns the value text and when it was last updated. Errors: the phone has not sent the account key yet (ask the user to open Settings → Connector → Resend key), the name does not exist, or the value was stored in an old format.

name.description: Variable name as stored (case-sensitive), e.g. 'home', 'mood', 'today.plan'. Names are set by askew_variables_set or by the phone's Shortcuts.

name: askew_variables_get
